summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Innovator Buffer Step-Up Strategy ETF (BSTP) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in downside hedge alternatives. The fund is actively managed, fund of funds, seeking to provide risk-managed exposure to SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust (ticker: SPY). BSTP was launched on Mar 8, 2022 and is issued by Innovator.
